dataClassification.name: Confidential
dataClassification.description: Disclosure causes business or personal harm.

components.description: A server-side API or backend service that processes requests and handles business logic (REST/GraphQL/RPC service).
A browser-rendered client (SPA or server-rendered pages with client-side JS) that renders user-controlled content.
The CI system that builds and tests the project on commits/PRs (e.g. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and has access to build-time secrets.
A container image (Docker/OCI) built and published as one of the project's deployment artifacts.
A persistent datastore (relational or NoSQL) storing application or user data.
Object or file storage (local disk, S3-compatible, etc.) holding uploaded or generated files.
A native or hybrid mobile client (iOS/Android).
The pipeline that packages and publishes release artifacts (binaries, packages, images) for distribution.
